Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack poisoning official software with malware using stolen code signing certificates
Discoverer: 401TRG, the Threat Research & Analysis Team at ProtectWise
Impacted Systems: Software and gaming organizations in United States, Japan, South Korea, and China
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing targeting IT staffers and internal security staff to collect credentials
Use of living off the land techniques with Windows utilities and penetration testing tools like Metasploit and Cobalt Strike
Hacking into Gmail and Office 365 accounts
Compromise of cloud providers to access cloud-based applications
